items.title: PM says Australia has 'ideological disagreement' with US after it reveals anti-slavery tariff
items.description: The planned new tariff is to be slapped on dozens of countries that have allegedly failed to take action to prevent slavery and forced labour.

items.title: US House votes to rein in Trump on Iran war
items.description: The US House of Representatives delivers President Donald Trump a rare rebuke, voting to halt military action in his war with Iran.

items.title: Elderly NSW couple stabbed, alleged intruder shot during home invasion
items.description: Two people in their 70s have been critically injured and an alleged intruder has been shot during an alleged home invasion in northern NSW this morning.

items.title: Live: Lower house passes first tranche of Labor's budget measures
items.description: The federal government's budget bill passes the House of Representatives without amendment, but it will need the support of the Greens to pass the next step. Follow live.

items.title: Netizens in China hunt for access to open internet as VPNs drop out
items.description: People in China say it is increasingly difficult to access the open internet, but they continue to find ways around Beijing's censorship apparatus.

items.title: Chinese spies using LinkedIn to steal secrets from recruits, Five Eyes warns
items.description: Australia and its partners in the Five Eyes intelligence alliance warn that Chinese spies are using job platforms to post fake ads to lure recruits with access to sensitive information.

items.title: Canberra Liberals say former leader's claim she was threatened with assault was 'misunderstanding'
items.description: The Canberra Liberals have distanced themselves from former leader Leanne Castley's allegation that she was threatened with physical assault, saying the remark related to an "animated discussion" that was quickly resolved.

items.title: Sydney nurses' alleged threats 'stupid things said by stupid people', court told
items.description: A lawyer acting for one of two Sydney nurses accused of making antisemitic threats via an online video chat app has told a court their actions were "stupid things said by stupid people".

items.title: The streaming platform exploding in popularity
items.description: Whether or not you've heard of the livestreaming platform Kick, there’s a good chance you’ll have seen clips from it. Kick has become home to some of the internet's most controversial creators — from celebrities and manosphere influencers to looksmaxxers.  But what is Kick, and why has it become such a major player in livestreaming?

items.title: Paedophile ex-magistrate Peter Liddy leaves prison after 25 years
items.description: Notorious paedophile ex-magistrate Peter Liddy has taken his first steps of freedom after serving a 25-year prison term for the sexual abuse of four children.

items.title: Teen's brutal death a flashpoint over violence against women and femicide
items.description: The alleged brutal murder of 14-year-old Agostina Vega in Argentina has reignited a generation-defining movement demanding justice for the women victims of crime and violence.

items.title: Motorcyclist says he owes his life to bystanders who lifted car off him
items.description: Tyler Weibe was on his way to work when the crash occurred on Brisbane's north side, leaving him with broken ribs, a broken collarbone and a collapsed lung.

items.title: White Australia's bid to remove hate listing dismissed
items.description: The High Court has dismissed an application by the group White Australia which had hoped to lift its listing as a hate group ahead of a formal High Court hearing later in the year.

items.title: Live: Big spending on health and housing in 'no surprises' SA budget
items.description: South Australia’s debt is projected to hit to more than $50 billion by 2029-30, with health taking up about one third of the budget. Follow live.

items.title: What happens when a Restoration Australia project takes five years
items.description: A planned 12-month build that's still underway three years later is the running joke of design shows. But what happens when you're a TV producer trying to make a series of it?

items.title: Who gets a public holiday on Monday?
items.description: Many Australians are about to have a long weekend thanks to the King's Birthday public holiday on Monday. But not everyone will have the day off.

items.title: How to move forward from estrangement
items.description: Experts say healing might involve reducing emotional distress and gaining clarity from the situation.

items.title: What's got the Pope and most Australians worried? This hyped new AI technology
items.description: Most Australians appear to distrust and dislike artificial intelligence despite using technology more than people in other countries.

items.title: EPA clashes with Greens on need for real-time tracking of salmon antibiotic use
items.description: The director of Tasmania's Environment Protection Authority rejects calls to release real-time information on the amount of antibiotics used by salmon producers, despite the companies already providing that information to other government bodies.

items.title: Boxing trainer suspended after neo-Nazi Sewell trained at his gym
items.description: ABC NEWS Verify can reveal that neo-Nazi Thomas Sewell has been training at a boxing gym in the outer-Melbourne suburb of Diamond Creek, a short drive from where he is living. The gym has been suspended by the sport's governing body.

items.title: Neo-Nazi hecklers found guilty over Anzac Day booing
items.description: Three white supremacists who loudly booed during a Welcome to Country ceremony at an Anzac Day dawn service in Melbourne have been found guilty of offensive behaviour and ordered to pay fines.

items.title: Pentagon hires convicted January 6 rioter for national security job
items.description: The Trump administration has given a man who was jailed for his actions during the January 6, 2021, US Capitol riot a job in the Pentagon's policy office.

items.title: Israel and Lebanon renew ceasefire but Hezbollah not present at talks
items.description: Lebanon and Israel have agreed to a ceasefire, according to a joint statement with the United States.

items.title: MP uses parliament to reveal threats to NZYQ deportees in Nauru
items.description: A cohort of former detainees deported to Nauru by the federal government have faced threats of violence and verbal abuse, independent MP Andrew Wilkie has revealed under parliamentary privilege.

items.title: Pat Cummins hoping to stay fit for 'unprecedented' 21-Test stretch
items.description: Australian men's captain Pat Cummins says his body is feeling "awesome" ahead of a hectic 12-month stretch of Test cricket.
